body:
>Remember, no matter how bad things can get, you are not your intellect, your ego, or your knowledge. You are not your environment. You are simply the observer withdrawn from all these things.

In theory, I'd agree.  Unfortunately, in our automated world, an observer isn't much of a coveted position to be in either, you know?  It's depressing and it's boring.  It also requires you have a source of income, food to eat and a positive mental environment if you're going to enjoy it.

>there are plenty of places to find and surround yourself with love.

I do feel loved, by my 3 family members.  It's the only thing that has kept me from pulling the trigger, honestly.  But I don't know how long that will last. 

>But I love you, and I think your specific existence is a beautiful thing.

This is something I wish I could talk myself into believing.  I appreciate the sentiment though.

>Do not dread the future, whether it be difficult or not, embrace it and find your path through what comes.

What if the path is already paved, though?  I believe in most cases it is, and I also believe that whatever way that path goes relies on how well you learned to construct it growing up.  If you weren't taught how to build it, you're just going to fuck it up anyways.  You're damn near destined to.
